data.one_liner: Read, create, edit and write XLSX Excel files in Dart/Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to decode XLSX bytes into workbook objects, manipulate sheets, rows, cells and styles, and encode back to bytes. Supports both client and server environments.
use_when: You need to import or export Excel spreadsheets without native platform code
You work with data tables that must be compatible with Microsoft Excel
avoid_when: You require advanced Excel features like macros, pivot tables, or complex chart generation
strengths: Pure Dart implementation works on all Flutter platforms
Strong typing for cell values with sealed classes
Supports custom number formats and date/time types
weaknesses: No support for Excel formulas evaluation or advanced features
Limited to XLSX; no XLS or CSV handling

alternatives.name: archive
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need to unzip XLSX files manually without high‑level Excel API
